def solve():
    import sys
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    max_removals = 0

    def dp(l, r):
        if l >= r:
            return 0
        res = 0
        for i in range(l, r):
            if (i > l and ord(s[i]) - ord(s[i-1]) == 1) or (i < r-1 and ord(s[i]) - ord(s[i+1]) == 1):
                res = max(res, dp(l, i) + dp(i+1, r) + 1)
        return res

    max_removals = dp(0, n)
    print(max_removals)
